svg.title: Daily GPP, TER and NEE from 14 days before to 28 days after the last day of a silage harvest, all 20 used episodes of the four grass sites together, as a fraction of the mean GPP of the 14 days before the harvest; mean and ± 1 SD over the episodes.
svg.desc: One panel. X axis: days from the last day of the harvest (−14 to +28, local days, UTC+2). Y axis: GPP, TER and NEE as a fraction of the mean GPP of the days −14 to −1 before the first day of the harvest, from −1.25 to 2.25 (NEE as a fraction of the GPP before: NEE < 0 = uptake, NEE = TER − GPP). Lines, all solid: GPP light blue with circles, TER light pink with squares, NEE steel blue with triangles; markers every 7 days. The band around each line is the mean ± 1 SD over the episodes; line and band are drawn only where 2 or more episodes have a value. An orange vertical line marks day 0 (the last day of the harvest), thin lines mark 1 and 0. All grass sites (n = 20; 19 to 20 episodes per day): change of days +1 to +14 against days −14 to −1 per episode, in percent of the GPP before: ΔGPP −48 % (SD 24, n 20), ΔTER −2 % (SD 26, n 20), ΔNEE 46 % (SD 29, n 20). Mean of the curve over days +1 to +14, as a fraction of the GPP before: GPP 0.52, TER 0.58, NEE 0.06; days +15 to +28: GPP 0.72, TER 0.61, NEE −0.11.
